milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate to and visually locate the jungle planks structure. Target is the center of the jungle planks structure at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5]. Max distance reduced to 5 blocks (from 16) to require actual navigation since spawn is ~7 blocks away. The 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must locate and look at the dark oak wall sign on the west face of the jungle planks structure. Target updated to [3, 1, 5] matching the corrected sign position (attached to solid jungle_planks block at [4,1,5], facing west). Max distance 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is close enough to read the sign text.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'talk to villager' requires the player to approach and face the villager to interact (right-click). Target is the villager's position at spawn-relative [15, 1, 5]. Max distance 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is within interaction range and facing the villager. This is the best available approximation since actual right-click interaction is not reliably detectable via info dict.
